metadata.title: International Versions of the Background Questionnaires Population 3 Final Year of Secondary School – 1995 Assessment User Guide for the TIMSS International Database Supplement 1 International Versions of the Background Questionnaires – Population 3

survey_design.weight_fields_interpretation: This document is a TIMSS International Database user guide supplement that provides international versions of background questionnaires for Population 3 (final year of secondary school). It does not report an analytic study with a defined student sample, nor does it specify any weighting or replicate-weighting scheme (e.g., W_FSTUWT, BRR, jackknife). For secondary analyses using TIMSS microdata, analysts should apply the complex survey design weights provided in the TIMSS International Database for population-representative estimates, and use the corresponding replicate weights if variance estimation is required. Because this supplement is questionnaire documentation rather than an empirical modeling paper, no weight variable names or replicate procedures are specified here.

data.handling_not_reported_explanation: Plausible values (PVs) are not applicable because this supplement does not analyze cognitive achievement outcomes or generate PV-based scores; it only documents the international background questionnaire items and their variable names. Missing-data handling is not reported because there is no empirical dataset construction, cleaning, or statistical analysis described—only questionnaire content and international adaptation instructions are provided.

sample_details.sample_filtering_criteria: Used for questionnaire documentation only: the supplement lists international background variables for TIMSS Population 3 student and school questionnaires and provides instructions for national adaptations. No analytic subsample or inclusion/exclusion criteria for a student dataset are defined in this document.

data.outcome_summary: This supplement is not an empirical results paper; it is a TIMSS International Database user guide supplement that documents the international versions of background questionnaires for Population 3 (final year of secondary school) and the associated variable names. It specifies two questionnaire instruments for contextual variables: the Student Questionnaire (SQ3) and the School Questionnaire (SCQ3), plus a Calculator Use Survey. The document explains that countries may adapt certain items or response options using NRC notes and international option placeholders, and it points users to a separate supplement for documentation of national adaptations needed for secondary analyses. Because it does not include an achievement scaling model, PV generation, or an analytic strategy, it provides no performance metrics or benchmarks; its practical value is enabling researchers to harmonize contextual variables across countries for TIMSS secondary data analyses.
data.null_fields_interpretation: This record is a questionnaire documentation supplement rather than an empirical study. As a result, there is no modeled dependent variable, no ML algorithm evaluation, no reported sample size, and no PV or missing-data handling procedure tied to an analysis pipeline. The sparse fields (e.g., no countries, no N, no findings) reflect the document’s purpose: to enumerate international background questionnaire items and their variable codes for TIMSS Population 3.
